title: -generAItor: Tree-in-the-Loop Text Generation for Language Model Explainability and Adaptation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a visual analytics tool (generAItor) for LLM explainability and adaptation. While it features a case study on social and gender biases (which includes specific examples like 'man of God' or 'witchcraft' in model predictions), its primary objective is the presentation of the tool and the 'tree-in-the-loop' paradigm rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, or ethics.
